issues.description: React hydration error: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated multiple times, causing the entire root to switch to client rendering. This is the primary broken element.
issues.element: Particle animation or dynamic text content in step-1 page
issues.root_cause: Some component in apps/web/app/design/step-1/page.tsx is rendering dynamic content (likely random particle positions, Math.random(), Date.now(), or similar non-deterministic values) during SSR that differs from client render. This causes React hydration mismatch. The particle canvas likely initializes with random values on the server that don't match client-side values.

issues.description: Gold particle animation is not visible on the dark navy canvas background as expected per spec.
issues.root_cause: The hydration error causes the entire root to fall back to client-side rendering, which may delay or break the canvas particle animation initialization. Additionally, the particle component may be using Math.random() during SSR causing the mismatch.
